Opposed.Title: Opposed roll
Opposed.Rule: Compare levels of success. The better level wins; on the same level, the participant with the higher skill value wins.

Pushing.Title: Pushing a roll
Pushing.Flow: Failure → describe a new risky approach → roll again. A second failure brings consequences set by the Keeper.

BonusPenalty.Title: Bonus and penalty dice
BonusPenalty.BonusRule: add a tens die and keep the lower tens result.
BonusPenalty.PenaltyRule: add a tens die and keep the higher tens result.

Combat.Title: Combat
Combat.InitiativeRule: in DEX order; a readied firearm uses DEX +50.
Combat.MeleeRule: the defender chooses Dodge or Fight Back; compare levels of success using the combat check rules.
Combat.FirearmsRule: a standard shot uses the normal difficulty; multiple shots and rate of fire depend on the weapon and may impose a penalty die.
Combat.CoverRule: costs the next attack; a successful Dodge imposes a penalty die on the attack against that target.
Combat.ManeuverRule: take one penalty die for each point the target exceeds your Build; a difference of 3 or more makes the maneuver impossible.

Damage.Title: Damage and major wounds
Damage.MajorWound: Damage from one attack ≥ ½ maximum HP → major wound and a CON roll to remain conscious.
Damage.ZeroHp: At 0 HP with a major wound the character is dying; end-of-round CON rolls determine survival until stabilized.

Medicine.Title: First Aid and Medicine
Medicine.FirstAidRule: a success restores 1 HP; on a dying character it stabilizes them until Medicine can be provided.
Medicine.MedicineRule: successful treatment of a major wound starts normal recovery; further healing follows the system rules.
